caption: The drawing depicts three black parasols on a plain beige background. At the top center is an open black parasol, depicted upright with a detailed frilled edge, a long central shaft, and a decorative handle at the bottom. In the lower left is a second parasol, also open, shown from below at an angle, with visible interior ribs and a similar frilled edge. On the lower right, there is a closed black parasol, lying horizontally with its pointed end to the left and the curved handle to the right. All three objects are rendered with attention to shading and texture, emphasizing the material and shape, and there are no additional objects or background elements in the composition.
title: Parasol
